sources.name: Rules
sources.content:
## Refunds
Unused grants may be returned before activation.

Refund requests must be sent to the helper channel within 14 days.

## Submission rules
Projects must be public on GitHub.

Reviewers reject submissions that copy tutorials without changes.

## AI policy
AI tools may generate at most 30% of project code.

## Hardware projects
Hardware projects must include a PCB schematic and a wiring diagram.

## Software projects
Software projects must include a README with setup steps.

## Payouts
Payouts are processed within 5 business days after approval.

## Login problems
If login redirects you in a loop, sign out and sign in again from the dashboard.
